name: Board Game Pieces
instruction: Create a set of board game pieces. They should be small and easily distinguishable from each other. Arrange them in a playful and scattered manner.

Shape accuracy: The set contains multiple distinct shapes for each game piece.
Each piece is small in size.
Color representation: The color set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Size: The size set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Proportion: The pieces in the board game are proportionate to the board.
Texture and surface detail: The texture and surface detail set in the script is reasonable for the object.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: The pieces are arranged in a playful manner.
The pieces are scattered rather than in a straight line.
Object distance and contact: There is adequate space between each piece for clear visibility.
No pieces overlap with each other.

Instruction execution accuracy: All pieces are distinguishable from each other.
The arrangement is playful and scattered as instructed.
